rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the specific contributions of millisecond pulsars and other sources to the gamma-ray flux of 47 Tuc or how future observations might resolve discrepancies in spectral properties. The papers are either adjacent, discussing related topics like gamma-ray emissions from pulsars in general, or unrelated.
